description.value: Vadapav Mirchi is a strictly vegetarian Indian restaurant specializing in Maharashtrian street food, with the signature dish being vada pav — a deep-fried spiced potato dumpling served in a bread bun with garlic chutney and fried green chillies. The menu spans traditional Maharashtra staples including Misal Pav, Pav Bhaji, Puran Poli, and Thalipeeth, representing a regional Indian cuisine rarely found in the Lower Mainland. A touring cyclist seeking a filling, meat-free meal near New Westminster's 12th Street corridor would find this a distinctive stop.
